status: Working research with a fresh independent local scoped review. Formal review and commit pending.

model.preparation: Single positive-w half sleeve has section r<R for 0<w<H and r<2R above H, where R=1.892410005412, H=L/2 and L=2.0918395048. Radius and reference length held. Steady 4D axisymmetric OpenSleeve fixes stationary current by feed phase, with both baths fixing amplitude. The side is reflecting in its moving frame. The displacement is Re[b exp(-i omega t)] f(w) cos(theta) with f=sin^2(pi w/H) on 0<w<H, zero elsewhere. Material degree of freedom is the GNLS carrier. This sharp, reflecting carrier boundary is separate from the smooth scalar-wave trapping well. Trace extrapolation and meshing refer to one section radius and one sleeve length. Matching the same fixed stationary rate for each control does not constitute a nonlinear time-dependent intake servo. The dipole perturbation changes integrated current by zero at first order by angular parity.
model.variational_force: In the rotating grand-canonical frame, S=integral_D [i hbar/2(psi*psi_t-cc) - k|grad psi|^2 - K|psi|^10/4 + mu |psi|^2], k=hbar^2/(2m). A moving natural wall imposes k partial_n psi=(i hbar/2) v_n psi. Then j_n=n v_n. With psi0=x+iy, delta psi=(X+iY)cos(theta), the linear pressure variation in real time is hbar(y Xdot - x Ydot)+2(mu-h)(xX+yY)-2k(x_w X_w+y_w Y_w). Multiply by (4pi R^2/3) f(w) and integrate to get induced fluid force. Shape-dependent values at fixed background add static in-phase contributions but no work over a periodic bend. Relative-angle normalization is integral cos^2(theta)=4pi/3; integral |grad_S cos(theta)|^2=8pi/3. This computes the generalized side traction under the chosen reflecting interface law.
model.response: Write the boundary-action cross term b(s^T u+t^T udot). The Hermitian bulk stiffness (half Hessian) for two quadratures includes angular l=1 kinetic energy, density Hessian and i omega hbar W J for exp(-i omega t). Source is (s+i omega t)b/2. Force per unit b is (s+i omega t)^dagger u/b. Positive work on the carrier is P=(omega/2)Im(F b*). Code label work_per_b2 is cycle-averaged POWER divided by peak-displacement squared. Energy per cycle =2pi P/omega, and C_eff=2P/(omega^2 |b|^2). Measured pressure directly on the side, the two terminal fluxes and a distinct downstream bond-current flux. Subtract the stationary state. The zero-flow control also measures radiation from fluid at rest. This is excess quadratic rotating-frame wave energy. Mean second-order transport times the chemical potential and controller changes would be needed for an absolute laboratory bath-energy ledger.
model.ports: Continue each selected AC cut by a uniform semi-infinite reflecting cylindrical waveguide at bath density, matched to mean outward DC current, with conserved radial finite-volume metric. At signed current, rotate local carrier phase by the discrete Bloch step m Q dw/(hbar n A) through arcsin and allow a DC chemical offset. Match decaying and outgoing energy-carrying roots of the quadrature recurrence. The actual finite DC state may have nonuniform terminal traces; the uniform continuation is an explicit boundary law for perturbations. Clamped AC ends set both angular quadratures to zero while leaving stationary mean intake unchanged. Doubling the length to the receiver termination and varying lead drift test this matching. Widening the downstream cylinder from 2R to 3R changes physical return/radiation impedance; neither geometry is an infinite 4D half-space. Zero-flow continuum solved independently with radial spherical Bessel modes and step aperture matching. Flowing quotients are direct finite-grid evaluations, with no rigorous continuum bound for the dissipative part.
model.support: Prescribed b cos(omega t), lossless dipole q, maintained coherent support at ws, coupling g cos(ws t)bq. In addition to the carrier work, the actuator does g bdot cos(ws t)q and the support does -g ws b sin(ws t)q. Their sum accounts for the change in dipole energy plus interaction. At the exact combination frequencies a single displacement drive forces q resonantly; its particular solution contains -g b t sin(wd t)/(4wd). Finite-time coherent transfer may go in either direction. Exclude this stored/driven energy from the steady retarded carrier loss. No additive positive damping was taken from it. With b imposed, the two sectors share the displacement and are otherwise independent at this order.
model.spectral_scope: An illustrative bend has measured-static K=6 by hypothesis and M=12. Rebase the induced force by subtracting its static field response, so unknown geometric static stiffness is contained once in K. No bare bend loss or intrinsic dipole dephasing. Sum measured retarded carrier forces for one arm or for two identical independent receiving arms coupled to the same bend; total flow in the latter is twice the per-arm intake. Grounded or transmitting AC feed does not change the prescribed per-arm DC intake. Chi_b=1/[K-M omega^2-N(Fr(omega)-Fr(0))]. At leading order the dipole energy-decay rate is g^2/(4wd) Im[chi_b(wd-ws)+chi_b(wd+ws)]. Near the line, keep the central dipole and the two directly coupled bend Fourier components, with F_r evaluated on both detuned sidebands and checked at two spectral sampling densities and two spatial meshes. Absorptive FWHM diagnoses a local single-pole linewidth, not the measured complete Floquet time-domain ringdown. Counts add two equal-area, selective cold single-jump Lorentzians, common shift, no pure dephasing and widths 1:3. Reviewer solved the merger condition at FWHM/gap=0.503226486865. The flowing 224-cell first-order rates and the 80-cell three-frequency widths use distinct objects. No charged/mirror-sensitive signal or calibrated companion acceleration is produced.
model.next: Replace the fixed-width receiver guide and ideal feed reflection with the outgoing response of the receiving bulk and brane feeding region. At the same prescribed bend, compare wave return and net radiated energy in this physical geometry. A final two-excitation conclusion also needs independent bend mass/stiffness, intrinsic loss, a calibrated readout and phase noise.

verdict: Scoped clear for the projected linear carrier work with the stated moving reflecting wall and AC lead models.
Scoped clear for the leading dipole energy-decay estimate and the stated conditional peak counts; the three-frequency FWHM is a local spectral check.
dispositions: Quantified mesh bias against a separate zero-current continuum calculation. Flowing minus resting uses the same grid.
Separated perturbation energy from mean bath transport, identified the real response as induced-field only, and included a separate coherent pump energy ledger.
Identified both physical AC reservoirs and which arm is driven. The conditional two-arm comparison holds intake fixed per arm, not in total. Peak counts require the stated readout.

"""Compare calibrated work, mesh changes and port physics in the finished runs."""
from pathlib import Path
from math import pi
r=Path('_scratch/s11c')
def rows(name,tag):
    return [dict(field.split('=',1) for field in line.split()[1:]) for line in (r/name/'stdout').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(tag+' ')]
flow=rows('carrier_bend_fine','work')
rest=rows('carrier_bend_rest224','control')
continuum=rows('referee_carrier_continuum01','modes=256')
coarse=rows('carrier_bend_work160','work')
def choose(table, **fields):
    found=[row for row in table if all(row.get(key)==val for key,val in fields.items())]
    assert len(found)==1,(len(found),fields)
    return found[0]
for row in flow:
    ports=row['ports']
    omega=row['omega']
    current=float(row['work_per_b2'])
    zero=float(choose(rest,ports=ports,omega=omega)['power_per_b2'])
    reference=choose(continuum,clamped='1' if ports=='receiver' else '0',omega=omega)
    exact=float(reference['power'])
    previous=float(choose(coarse,ports=ports,omega=omega)['work_per_b2'])
    print(f"compare ports={ports} omega={omega} throughput_power_change_percent={100*(current-zero)/zero:.10g} "
          f"zero_grid_vs_continuum_percent={100*(zero-exact)/exact:.10g} "
          f"mesh160_to224_percent={100*(current-previous)/current:.10g} cycle_energy_at_1e5={2*pi*1e-10*current/float(omega):.12g} "
          f"feed_fraction={float(row['feed_per_b2'])/current:.10g} C={row['effective_C']}")

referee_carrier_step_green01.independent_or_summary_script_as_run:
"""Radiation from a moving Neumann sleeve into two half-guides at zero flow.

Use symmetric/antisymmetric Bogoliubov polarizations in phase-shifted real
coordinates and image Green functions on two free-ended half-chains. Their
only unknown is the bond force across the aperture. There are no finite ports
and no two-dimensional response solve. Unit physical wall displacement.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh
import yaml


def radial(cells, dr):
    edges = np.arange(cells+1)*dr
    measure = 4*np.pi*np.diff(edges**3)/9
    difference = np.diff(np.eye(cells), axis=0)
    grad = difference.T @ ((4*np.pi/3*edges[1:-1]**2/dr)[:,None]*difference)
    polar = 8*np.pi/3*dr*np.eye(cells)
    eigen, phi = eigh(grad+polar, np.diag(measure))
    return measure, eigen, phi


def axial(lam, dz, kappa, shift):
    cosk = 1 + dz**2*(lam + shift/kappa)/2
    z = np.empty(len(lam), complex)
    open_ = abs(cosk)<1
    z[open_] = np.exp(1j*np.arccos(cosk[open_]))
    closed = cosk[~open_]
    z[~open_] = 1/(closed+np.sign(closed)*np.sqrt(closed**2-1))
    return z, dz/kappa/(1/z-z), open_


def response(cells, radius, length, kappa, hbar, g, omega):
    dw = length/(2*cells)
    dr = radius/cells
    measure, lam_l, phi_l = radial(cells,dr)
    _, lam_r, phi_r = radial(2*cells,dr)
    distance = np.arange(cells)
    axial_shape = np.sin(2*np.pi*(length/2-(distance+.5)*dw)/length)**2
    boundary_quad = (4*np.pi/3)*radius**2
    proj = (9*phi_l[-1] - phi_l[-2])/8
    shifts, pol = eigh([[2*g,hbar*omega],[hbar*omega,0]])
    p_l, p_r, direct = 0, 0, 0
    for shift, phase_weight in zip(shifts,pol[1]):
        zl, gl, ol = axial(lam_l,dw,kappa,shift)
        zr, gr, or_ = axial(lam_r,dw,kappa,shift)
        force = (-hbar*omega*phase_weight/2*boundary_quad*dw*
                 proj[:,None]*axial_shape)
        image_l = gl*(1+zl)
        image_r = gr*(1+zr)
        wall_to_cut = image_l[:,None]*zl[:,None]**distance
        field_free_end = phi_l @ (wall_to_cut*force).sum(axis=1)
        narrow_compliance = (phi_l*image_l)@phi_l.T
        aperture = phi_r[:cells]
        wide_compliance = (aperture*image_r)@aperture.T
        t = np.linalg.solve(narrow_compliance+wide_compliance+np.diag(dw/kappa/measure),-field_free_end)
        left_interface = phi_l.T@t
        right_interface = -aperture.T@t
        zo=zl[ol,None]
        a_l = gl[ol]*((zo**(-distance)+zo**(1+distance))*force[ol]).sum(axis=1) + image_l[ol]*left_interface[ol]
        a_r = image_r[or_]*right_interface[or_]
        p_l += omega*kappa/dw*(zl[ol].imag*abs(a_l)**2).sum()
        p_r += omega*kappa/dw*(zr[or_].imag*abs(a_r)**2).sum()
        for d in distance:
            G = gl[:,None]*(zl[:,None]**abs(d-distance) + zl[:,None]**(1+d+distance))
            field = (G*force).sum(axis=1) + wall_to_cut[:,d]*left_interface
            direct += omega*(force[:,d]@field).imag
    return direct, p_l, p_r


if __name__=='__main__':
    archive = yaml.safe_load(Path('software/stage1_solver/reports/pathA_26_derrick_results.yaml').read_text())
    params = archive['parameters']
    hbar = params['hbar']
    runs = json.loads(Path('research/pde_ledger_v3/_measurements/mouth_trapped_wave_spectrum.json').read_text())['runs']
    def value(run,key,tag):
        line, = (s for s in runs[run]['stdout_lines'] if s.startswith(tag))

"""Continuum, zero-current, spherical-Bessel guide-aperture matching.

The interface traction is expanded on narrow l=1 Neumann transverse modes.
Wide guide modes implement free-boundary compliance with the traction
extended by zero on the rigid shelf. Both half-lines radiate to infinity.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import spherical_jn
from scipy.optimize import brentq
import yaml


def spectrum(radius,narrow,wide):
    x = np.array([brentq(lambda x: spherical_jn(1,x,True),
                         (n-.5)*np.pi,n*np.pi) for n in range(1,wide+1)])
    overlap_weight = 4*np.pi/3
    norm = 1 / np.sqrt(overlap_weight*radius**3/2*
                       (spherical_jn(1,x)**2-spherical_jn(0,x)*spherical_jn(2,x)))
    kn,kw = x[:narrow]/radius,x/(2*radius)
    phin = norm[:narrow]*spherical_jn(1,x[:narrow])
    dwide = norm/np.sqrt(8)*kw*spherical_jn(1,kw*radius,True)
    # Green's transverse identity, since the narrow-mode slope at the lip vanishes.
    overlap = overlap_weight*radius**2*np.outer(dwide,phin)/(kn[None,:]**2-kw[:,None]**2)
    return kn,kw,phin,overlap


def gamma(k, shift,kappa):
    v=k**2+shift/kappa
    return np.where(v<0,-1j*np.sqrt(abs(v)),np.sqrt(abs(v))+0j),v<0


def shape_integral(beta, sleeve):
    # Laplace transform of sin(pi*z/sleeve)^2 on [0,sleeve].
    p=2*np.pi/sleeve
    return -np.expm1(-beta*sleeve)*p**2/(2*beta*(beta**2+p**2))


def response(modes,radius,length,kappa,hbar,g,omega,clamped):
    kn,kw,phin,Q = spectrum(radius,modes,3*modes)
    shifts,pol = np.linalg.eigh([[2*g,hbar*omega],[hbar*omega,0]])
    pl,pr=0.,0.
    info=None
    for shift,phase_weight in zip(shifts,pol[1]):
        gn,ol=gamma(kn,shift,kappa)
        gw,ow=gamma(kw,shift,kappa)
        if ol.any():
            info=(ol.sum(),ow.sum(),np.min(abs(gn.imag[ol])),np.min(abs(gw.imag[ow])))
        cn,cw=1/(kappa*gn),1/(kappa*gw)
        B=-hbar*omega*phase_weight/2*4*np.pi/3*radius**2*phin
        if clamped:
            tail=np.exp(-gn*length/2)
            # Feed fixes both field quadratures at d=length/2. The shape
            # is symmetric in the sleeve, so its reflected integral uses
            # only decaying exponentials even in high evanescent channels.
            pfree = cn*B*shape_integral(gn,length/2)*(1-tail)/(1+tail**2)
            narrow_compliance = cn*(1-tail**2)/(1+tail**2)
        else:
            pfree = cn*B*shape_integral(gn,length/2)
            narrow_compliance = cn
        traction = np.linalg.solve(np.diag(narrow_compliance)+(Q.T*cw)@Q,-pfree)
        z=gn[ol]
        a_l = cn[ol]*(traction[ol]+B[ol]*(shape_integral(z,length/2)+shape_integral(-z,length/2))/2)
        a_r = -cw[ow]*(Q[ow]@traction)
        if not clamped:
            pl += omega*kappa*(-gn[ol].imag*abs(a_l)**2).sum()
        pr += omega*kappa*(-gw[ow].imag*abs(a_r)**2).sum()
    return pl,pr,info


if __name__=='__main__':
    archive=yaml.safe_load(Path('software/stage1_solver/reports/pathA_26_derrick_results.yaml').read_text())
    params=archive['parameters']
    runs=json.loads(Path('research/pde_ledger_v3/_measurements/mouth_trapped_wave_spectrum.json').read_text())['runs']
    def val(run,tag,key):
        line,=(s for s in runs[run]['stdout_lines'] if s.startswith(tag))
        return float(dict(t.split('=',1) for t in line.split() if '=' in t)[key])
    length=val('smooth_dipole_l015_01','point n=1 ','L')
    for modes in [16,32,64,128,256]:
        for key in ['difference','sum']:
            w=val('mouth_wave_linewidth_budget01','bow h=0.015 ',key)
            for clamped in [False,True]:
                l,r,info=response(modes,archive['phase_A']['q_star'][0],length,params['hbar']**2/(2*params['m']),params['hbar'],5*params['K_eos'],w,clamped)
                nl,nr,kl,kr=info
                print(f"modes={modes} clamped={int(clamped)} omega={w:.12g} power={l+r:.12g} feed={l:.12g} receiver={r:.12g} open={nl},{nr} min_axial_k={kl:.7g},{kr:.7g}",flush=True)

"""Count maxima directly from the derivative polynomial for the stated readout."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial import Polynomial as Poly
from scipy.optimize import root

x=Poly([0.,1.])
def stationary(ratio):
    a=ratio/2
    return x*((x+1)**2+9*a*a)**2+3*(x+1)*(x*x+a*a)**2

def merge(v):
    t,r=v
    p=stationary(r)
    return (p(t),p.deriv()(t))

cross=root(merge,[-.7,.65],tol=1e-12)
assert cross.success
print("fold_position=%.12g fold_FWHM_over_gap=%.12g"%tuple(cross.x))
for file in ["carrier_bend_spectrum160","carrier_bend_lines48","carrier_bend_lines80"]:
    for line in Path("_scratch/s11c",file,"stdout").read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(("transfer ","lineshape ")):
            continue
        f=dict(v.split("=",1) for v in line.split() if "=" in v)
        r=float(f.get("width_over_gap",f.get("loss_over_conservative_gap")))
        p=stationary(r)
        maxima=[z.real for z in p.roots() if abs(z.imag)<1e-7 and p.deriv()(z.real)>0]
        print(f"file={file} ports={f['ports']} arms={f.get('arms',f.get('identical_arms'))} ratio={r:.12g} derivative_maxima={len(maxima)}")
